records.title: Kane finished a step. Did the whole command finish?
records.short_answer: First identify the command family. A completion event for one step is not necessarily completion of the enclosing command.

documented_notes.text: Agent Mode emits newline-delimited JSON on stdout. One-shot run finishes with run_end. For testmd run, the file-level completion is test_md_done; run_end events inside that stream can represent individual steps. Check the process exit code as well; some early exits have no normal completion event.
The modes documentation distinguishes a failed run or upload, an execution/setup error, and a cancellation or timeout. Do not infer an application defect from every nonzero exit.

aeg_suggestions: Ask for the command family and installed CLI version before proposing a parser change.
When the expected completion event is absent, report incomplete evidence rather than inventing a passing result.
applies_when: A coding agent is interpreting Kane command output.
does_not_establish: That any local Kane command was run.
That a task, fix, or transfer has been verified.
records.discussion_prompt: Which command family did you use, which completion event did you observe, and did the process exit? Share only a reviewed excerpt.

records.title: Can I share a failed Kane run without exposing private data?
records.short_answer: Start with a reviewed, minimal summary. Do not treat an entire evidence pack as public-safe by default.

documented_notes.text: Evidence packs can include the objective, outcomes, runner name and email, screenshots, browser console/network logs, and execution logs.

The evidence serve viewer reads a sealed pack through a loopback server without uploading it. This viewing behavior is separate from running tests: the Test Manager documentation describes default session uploads, including screenshots and run artifacts, and publication of replay evidence.

Evidence validation checks structure, integrity, and completeness. A producer verdict can remain passed even when a failed or broken step triggers a validation warning; the validator does not replace the producer verdict.

aeg_suggestions: Review screenshots and text for credentials, private URLs, account details, personal data, and employer material before sharing.
Keep the original pack unchanged in its approved location. Share a separate sanitized summary or approved derivative, with provenance and access restrictions.
Do not equate a structurally valid pack with a correct fix or a privacy guarantee.
applies_when: A developer wants help with a run without publishing the full raw artifacts.
does_not_establish: That a local viewer prevents earlier run uploads.
That evidence contents have been independently reproduced.
records.discussion_prompt: What is the smallest reviewed excerpt that explains the failure? Keep credentials and raw private artifacts out of the room.

records.title: The first screen looks right. What should I check after a click?
records.short_answer: Discuss the state transitions and the behavior that must remain true, not only what the initial page displays.

documented_notes.text: Kane testmd represents a flow as named Markdown steps with plain-language objectives; the official examples combine actions and observable checks. The documentation distinguishes one-shot run from saved tests intended for reuse.

aeg_suggestions: As a discussion exercise, identify the initial state, one meaningful action, the resulting visible state, and the invariant being checked.
Consider a repeated action, an invalid input, and a successful path when relevant. A passing initial screen does not establish the later states.
This reference is not an executable Kane test, an actual run, or a claim that Kane discovered a defect.
applies_when: A developer is choosing what to observe in an interactive Web flow.
does_not_establish: Correctness of the already-frozen phone fixtures.
Any Kane execution before Hack Day.
records.discussion_prompt: Which user action could change the result after the first screen, and what should remain true afterward?
